# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: nil, ??, known() — the one unknown rule (spec 2.4).
# UNKNOWN propagates: it never faults and never silently becomes a value. `??`
# gives it a default, known() is the one test that asks about it, and a tested
# unknown poisons the test's answer everywhere, including filter / any / all.

== the nil literal
expr nil
want nil

== coalesce keeps a known value
env level: num = 5
expr level ?? 0
want num 5

== coalesce replaces an unknown
expr (1 / 0) ?? 42
want num 42

== the nil literal coalesces away
expr nil ?? 7
want num 7

== coalesce chains left
expr nil ?? nil ?? 3
want num 3

== coalesce binds looser than arithmetic
expr (1 / 0) ?? 2 + 3
want num 5

== a ternary arm carries a coalesce
env on: bool = true
expr on ? (1 / 0) ?? 9 : 0
want num 9

== a coalesce default resolves against the equality's enum
env mode: enum(idle, run, fault) = run
expr mode == (((1 / 0 > 0) ? .fault : .idle) ?? .run)
want bool true

== known on a value
env level: num = 5
expr known(level)
want bool true

== known on an unknown
expr known(1 / 0)
want bool false

== known is the unknown test
expr known(nil)
want bool false

== known guards a condition
expr known(1 / 0) && false
want bool false

== equality cannot test for unknown
env level: num = 5
expr level == nil
error cannot test for it; write known

== inequality cannot test for unknown either
env level: num = 5
expr nil != level
error cannot test for it; write known

== an unknown filter condition poisons the answer
env temps: list(num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.filter(v => v / 0 > 0).length()
want nil

== an unknown any condition poisons the answer
env temps: list(num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.any(v => v / 0 > 0)
want nil

== an unknown all condition poisons the answer
env temps: list(num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.all(v => v / 0 > 0)
want nil

== a decided filter still filters
env temps: list(num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.filter(v => v > 1).length()
want num 2

== a map body may carry gaps
env temps: list(num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.map(v => v / 0).length()
want num 3

== an unknown condition in a conditional is unknown
expr (1 / 0 > 0) ? 1 : 2
want nil
